name: European gas (TTF)
summary: European gas near €92/MWh, far above the €70 Alert line
state: Dutch TTF gas closed near €92/MWh on 3 Nov, far above the €70 Alert line, though 8.6% lower on the week on hopes of US–Iran talks. Hormuz, the route for Qatari LNG, remained largely shut, and a Qatari LNG carrier was attacked on 31 Oct (CBS).
for_you: Wholesale gas costs feed into household energy bills and the Ofgem price cap with a lag; energy-intensive firms are most exposed.

sources.title: CBS News — Iran war live updates

why: European gas sets UK and EU power prices and heating bills; Europe has had no cushion since losing Russian pipeline gas.
drivers: LNG supply, storage levels, weather, Norwegian outages, Middle East LNG routes.

rubric.alert: TTF > €70/MWh, or a major supply cut-off (e.g. Qatar LNG or Norway outage > 1 week).
rubric.watch: TTF €40–70/MWh, or storage > 10 points below seasonal norm.
rubric.normal: TTF < €40/MWh and EU storage at or above seasonal norm.
